title: Coordinate influence relative error
statement: For each natural number $w$, let $d_w$ be the critical dimension and let $I_w$ be the coordinate influence used for the critical tribes function. Define the coordinate influence relative error to be $I_w d_w/\log(d_w)-1$, where $\log$ is the natural logarithm.
caveat: The payload gives no definitions of the critical dimension or coordinate influence.
